header_sentences: See Apply, and also see Press.

contexts.text: Each and all things have a signification according to the subject to which they are applied. AC 4307. AC 4502.
A morose man... does not apply himself, and study to bend minds.
With application to the geniuses, and thus admission into the minds of others.
In his first age, man... can apply certain things, not to his own life, but to that of others.
(The application of the affections of truth to goods and truths, Signified.) AC 4073:2. AC 4096. AC 4096:3, Explained. AC 4096:5. AC 4096:end.
(This was done) for the sake of application, and thence of conjunction.
Divine Good cannot apply itself to other vessels than genuine truths...
The hatching of falsities by applying truths, and thus persuading. Signified.
Truths then... through application to evil become falsities.
And (Jacob) encamped at the face of the city = application, to wit, to the goods of that truth. Explained.
She caught him in his garment = that truth not spiritual applied itself to the ultimate of spiritual truth.
Theft = the claiming of the things of others... when it applies (goods and truths) to evils and falsities.
By this is signified that good is adjoined to truth in the Natural, if only the Natural applies itself and obeys. Explained.
And (Joseph) lifted up portions from his faces to them = goods applied to each one from mercy.
And they drank = the application of truths under good.
If the Infernals are applied, they induce diseases, and at last death.
Evil Spirits... have often and long applied themselves, and according to their presence have induced pains, and also diseases...
When they are applied to a man, they induce a great pain through weariness...
The Scientific, which has not been perverted through applications to falsities and to evils.
All Egypt came to Joseph = application to the Internal.
Expressions are to be applied to their own subject that is being treated of.
They would apply the things that are of intelligence in favour of evil.

All the Egyptians dug around the river waters to drink = the investigation of truth which they might apply to falsities. To drink = to apply to falsities... for he who drinks, applies to himself. But it is to be known that application takes place according to the quality and state of him who applies to himself. He who is in the affection of truth, applies to himself truths according to the state and quality of the affection. He who is in the affection of falsity, when he applies truths to himself, perverts and falsifies them...

Because they could not drink of the waters of the river = no application from mere falsities... Truths cannot be applied to mere falsities; that is, be falsified through mere falsities... The reason is, that they are entirely opposite; and opposites cannot be applied unless there are intermediates which conjoin...
With these, the good that is of love and the truth that is of wisdom are explained in a sinister manner, and are applied in favour of evil and thence of falsity.

They almost put off the quality of falsity, which is effected through application to good; for such falsities can be applied to good, and they can be applied to evil; if to good, they become mild, but if to evil, they become hard; for falsities can equally be applied to good, as truths to evil; for all truths whatever, by applications to evil, are falsified. Example(s).
To drink waters = to receive truths, and to apply them under good.

Draw near before Jehovah = a state of reception, and application to it... The reason why it is also application, is because reception is not anything, unless there is also application, namely, to use. Explained.
Moses went forth to meet his father-in-law = the application of truth Divine to Divine Good. AC 8666.
Application precedes conjunction.
This is effected... through sinister applications of truths, with the evil.
Stealing a man and selling him = the application of the truth of faith to evil, and alienation.

That they are condemned who apply the truths of faith to evils, and thus alienate them from themselves, is because they had formerly acknowledged them; for the truth of faith that has once been acknowledged, when it is afterwards applied to evil, is commingled with falsity from evil; hence is profanation.
He came to me, applying himself to the left side...
Hollow boarded shalt thou make (the altar) = application.
Thou shalt make the bullock approach = a state of the application of the natural... man such as there is in his early childhood.

By the faculty of being wise, is meant... the faculty of clearly discerning what is true and good, of choosing what is suitable, and of applying to the uses of life. They who ascribe all things to the Lord do thus clearly discern, choose, and apply.
When truths Divine are applied to man's loves they are no longer truths, since evil enters them by the applications...
(The incense) shall be holy to thee to Jehovah = that worship is to be applied to love Divine.

The other conjunction is profanation; this takes place when evil is applied to truth and truth to evil; which is effected through a sinister application of truth, and application to evil, and thus through the insertion of one into the other.
In proportion as a man learns and applies to life, he becomes intelligent and wise... HH 356.
They who have immediately applied to life the doctrinal things of the Church that are from the Word are in the Inmost Heaven...
Man is continually withdrawn by the Lord from the evils which, from consociation with these Spirits, he applies to himself, and as it were attracts...
The application may be made...
Into these degrees no others ascend and are elevated than they who in the world have been in truths, and have applied them to life.
This... may seem doubtful, because not illustrated by application to sensible and perceptible things in nature. DLW 228.
Let application be made of these things to...
Abstract things... are usually better comprehended than applied ones...

(A man of no remarkable learning, who after death spoke like an Angel.) The reason was that in the world he had applied to life the precepts of the Word, and had worshipped the Lord, and thence he was elevated by the Lord into the third degree of love and wisdom. DLW 427:3.
The third kind of profanation is [committed] by those who apply the sense of the letter of the Word to confirm evil loves and false principles. Explained.
That the male is born to become intellectual... may be seen from... his application, etc... From his application, which is to such things as are of the understanding...

But that the female is born to be voluntary from the Intellectual of the man... may also be evident from... her application, etc... From her application, which is to such things as are works of the hands...
A wife conjoins herself to the man by applications to the yearnings of his will.
Merely natural Spirits are cold with an intense cold when they apply themselves to the side of any Angel who is in a state of love.
These things may be thus applied to the Omnipresence of God...
Everything takes thence... and applies to itself as much as is sufficient.
Under Accommodation, see this reference.
Redemption... is not applicable, ascribable, or imputable to any man... TCR 640:end. TCR 642. TCR 649.
On those who inhere in general truth without application to circumstances. Example(s).
